items.title: US-Iran conflict / Strait of Hormuz
items.detail: US reinstated naval blockade of Iranian ports; strikes traded overnight; Iran threatens regional energy exports. Brent ~$84.95, third straight gain. Energy-shock risk to the disinflation story.

items.title: Memory-chip correction spreading
items.detail: MU -8.5%, WDC -9.8%, SNDK -8.9%, Dell -14% (Jul 15) on CXMT's planned $8.55B IPO and CoreWeave hedging memory costs. If memory pricing tops, a chunk of 2026 AI earnings-revision fuel goes with it.

items.title: Two-sided Fed risk into Jul 28-29 FOMC
items.detail: June PPI -0.3% m/m says disinflation; yet some desks price ~60% odds of a September HIKE. Rates 3.50-3.75%, 10Y 4.57%. A hawkish surprise hits long-duration tech hardest.

items.title: VIX 15.67 complacency vs war headlines
items.detail: Vol this low while a naval blockade is active leaves the tape unhedged against escalation gaps.

items.title: Concentration: Mag-7 + AAPL record high
items.detail: NVDA alone 7.46% of S&P; leadership narrowed again as megacaps absorbed the chip selloff. Breadth beneath (41 small-cap 52wk highs) is selective, not broad.

items.title: Earnings-season event risk
items.detail: TSMC prints today Jul 16; SLB Jul 17; heavy tech guides ahead. ASML's beat-and-raise set a high bar for semicap.

items.title: Space/IPO sentiment wobble
items.detail: SpaceX (SPCX) traded below its IPO price for the first time this week — a sentiment tell for speculative growth supply.
